en: A vintage black‑and‑white photograph showing a gently rolling landscape with grassy hills and scattered trees. A small group of taller trees stands on the crest of the main hill to the left, with a narrow path leading up to it. In the foreground and lower areas there are dense bushes or low trees, and a dirt track runs off into the distance on the right. At the bottom right of the image, handwritten text reads "Kuldīga."
